mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LISTINGS ( HOST_USER_ID, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, ROOM_TYPE, DEAL_TYPE, DEPOSIT, MONTHLY_RENT, MAINTENANCE_FEE, AREA_M2, FLOOR, TOTAL_FLOOR, ROOM_COUNT, BATHROOM_COUNT, ADDRESS_ROAD, ADDRESS_DETAIL, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, GEO_POINT, STATUS, SOURCE, BROKER_NAME, BROKER_PHONE, BROKER_OFFICE_PHONE, BROKER_OFFICE_NAME ) VALUES ( #{hostUserId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{roomType}, #{dealType}, #{deposit}, #{monthlyRent}, #{maintenanceFee}, #{areaM2}, #{floor}, #{totalFloor}, #{roomCount}, #{bathroomCount}, #{addressRoad}, #{addressDetail}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{longitude}, ' ', #{latitude}, ')'), 4326, 'axis-order=long-lat'), #{status}, #{source}, #{brokerName}, #{brokerPhone}, #{brokerOfficePhone}, #{brokerOfficeName} )

INSERT INTO LISTING_IMAGES (LISTING_ID, S3_URL, SORT_ORDER, IS_COVER) VALUES
(#{listingId}, #{url}, #{i}, TRUEFALSE)

INSERT INTO LISTING_OPTIONS (LISTING_ID, OPTION_ID) SELECT #{listingId}, O.OPTION_ID FROM OPTIONS O WHERE O.CODE IN
#{code}
mapper.select:
SELECT L.LISTING_ID, L.TITLE, L.ROOM_TYPE, L.DEAL_TYPE, L.DEPOSIT, L.MONTHLY_RENT, L.AREA_M2, L.ROOM_COUNT, L.BATHROOM_COUNT, L.ADDRESS_ROAD, L.LATITUDE, L.LONGITUDE, L.VIEW_COUNT, L.STATUS, L.REJECT_REASON, (SELECT LI.S3_URL FROM LISTING_IMAGES LI WHERE LI.LISTING_ID = L.LISTING_ID ORDER BY LI.IS_COVER DESC, LI.SORT_ORDER ASC LIMIT 1) AS COVER_IMAGE_URL,
CASE WHEN F.USER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS FAVORITED
FALSE AS FAVORITED
FROM LISTINGS L
LEFT JOIN FAVORITES F ON F.LISTING_ID = L.LISTING_ID AND F.USER_ID = #{viewerUserId}
ORDER BY L.MONTHLY_RENT ASC, L.DEPOSIT ASC ORDER BY L.MONTHLY_RENT DESC, L.DEPOSIT DESC ORDER BY L.VIEW_COUNT DESC ORDER BY L.CREATED_AT DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT L.LISTING_ID, L.TITLE, L.ROOM_TYPE, L.DEAL_TYPE, L.DEPOSIT, L.MONTHLY_RENT, L.AREA_M2, L.ROOM_COUNT, L.BATHROOM_COUNT, L.ADDRESS_ROAD, L.LATITUDE, L.LONGITUDE, L.VIEW_COUNT, L.STATUS, L.REJECT_REASON, (SELECT LI.S3_URL FROM LISTING_IMAGES LI WHERE LI.LISTING_ID = L.LISTING_ID ORDER BY LI.IS_COVER DESC, LI.SORT_ORDER ASC LIMIT 1) AS COVER_IMAGE_URL,
CASE WHEN F.USER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS FAVORITED
FALSE AS FAVORITED
FROM LISTINGS L
LEFT JOIN FAVORITES F ON F.LISTING_ID = L.LISTING_ID AND F.USER_ID = #{viewerUserId}
ORDER BY L.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT L.LISTING_ID, L.TITLE, L.ROOM_TYPE, L.DEAL_TYPE, L.DEPOSIT, L.MONTHLY_RENT, L.AREA_M2, L.ROOM_COUNT, L.BATHROOM_COUNT, L.ADDRESS_ROAD, L.LATITUDE, L.LONGITUDE, L.VIEW_COUNT, L.STATUS, L.REJECT_REASON, (SELECT LI.S3_URL FROM LISTING_IMAGES LI WHERE LI.LISTING_ID = L.LISTING_ID ORDER BY LI.IS_COVER DESC, LI.SORT_ORDER ASC LIMIT 1) AS COVER_IMAGE_URL, FALSE AS FAVORITED FROM LISTINGS L WHERE L.HOST_USER_ID = #{hostUserId} AND L.DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY L.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT L.LISTING_ID, L.HOST_USER_ID, U.NICKNAME AS HOST_NICKNAME, L.TITLE, L.DESCRIPTION, L.ROOM_TYPE, L.DEAL_TYPE, L.DEPOSIT, L.MONTHLY_RENT, L.MAINTENANCE_FEE, L.AREA_M2, L.FLOOR, L.TOTAL_FLOOR, L.ROOM_COUNT, L.BATHROOM_COUNT, L.ADDRESS_ROAD, L.ADDRESS_DETAIL, L.LATITUDE, L.LONGITUDE, L.STATUS, L.SOURCE, L.VIEW_COUNT, L.BROKER_NAME, L.BROKER_PHONE, L.BROKER_OFFICE_PHONE, L.BROKER_OFFICE_NAME FROM LISTINGS L JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = L.HOST_USER_ID WHERE L.LISTING_ID = #{listingId} AND L.DELETED_AT IS NULL
SELECT HOST_USER_ID FROM LISTINGS WHERE LISTING_ID = #{listingId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
SELECT O.CODE FROM LISTING_OPTIONS LO JOIN OPTIONS O ON O.OPTION_ID = LO.OPTION_ID WHERE LO.LISTING_ID = #{listingId} ORDER BY O.OPTION_ID ASC
SELECT SUMMARY_TEXT FROM LISTING_AI_SUMMARY WHERE LISTING_ID = #{listingId}
mapper.update: UPDATE LISTINGS SET TITLE = #{title}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, ROOM_TYPE = #{roomType}, DEAL_TYPE = #{dealType}, DEPOSIT = #{deposit}, MONTHLY_RENT = #{monthlyRent}, MAINTENANCE_FEE = #{maintenanceFee}, AREA_M2 = #{areaM2}, FLOOR = #{floor}, TOTAL_FLOOR = #{totalFloor}, ROOM_COUNT = #{roomCount}, BATHROOM_COUNT = #{bathroomCount}, ADDRESS_ROAD = #{addressRoad}, ADDRESS_DETAIL = #{addressDetail}, LATITUDE = #{latitude}, LONGITUDE = #{longitude}, GEO_POINT = ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{longitude}, ' ', #{latitude}, ')'), 4326, 'axis-order=long-lat'), STATUS = #{status}, BROKER_NAME = #{brokerName}, BROKER_PHONE = #{brokerPhone}, BROKER_OFFICE_PHONE = #{brokerOfficePhone}, BROKER_OFFICE_NAME = #{brokerOfficeName} WHERE LISTING_ID = #{listingId} AND HOST_USER_ID = #{hostUserId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
UPDATE LISTINGS SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE LISTING_ID = #{listingId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
UPDATE LISTINGS SET VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT + 1 WHERE LISTING_ID = #{listingId}

SELECT L.GU_CODE AS REGION_CODE, L.GU_NAME AS REGION_NAME, 'GU' AS REGION_TYPE, AVG(L.LATITUDE) AS CENTER_LAT, AVG(L.LONGITUDE) AS CENTER_LNG, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM LISTINGS L
AND L.GU_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY L.GU_CODE, L.GU_NAME ORDER BY CNT DESC

SELECT L.DONG_CODE AS REGION_CODE, L.DONG_NAME AS REGION_NAME, 'DONG' AS REGION_TYPE, AVG(L.LATITUDE) AS CENTER_LAT, AVG(L.LONGITUDE) AS CENTER_LNG, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM LISTINGS L
AND L.DONG_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY L.DONG_CODE, L.DONG_NAME ORDER BY CNT DESC
